notes: Setup: steps that read your Sheet open straight away with the copy kept from last time, and update themselves if the Sheet has anything newer
Saving no longer holds you up – in setup you can press Next while the family saves (the calendar waits for it), and in the Configurator nothing locks while Google saves
A 'Saving… you can carry on – keep this page open' note shows while anything is on its way, the Save button turns to ✅ Saved when it's done, and closing the page before then asks first
